mapper.select: SELECT id, username, email, nickname, status, is_admin, create_time, update_time, delete_at FROM t_user WHERE delete_at = 0 AND username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%') ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user SET used_space = GREATEST(0, COALESCE(used_space, 0) + #{delta}), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{userId} AND delete_at = 0

UPDATE t_user SET used_space = COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(size) FROM t_file_node WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 'file' AND source_type = 'local'), 0) + COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(total_size) FROM t_recycle_bin WHERE user_id = #{userId}), 0), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{userId} AND delete_at = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_user WHERE delete_at > 0 AND delete_at < #{cutoff}
